name: Bullseye
description: Bullseye was a popular British television programme. It was first made for the ITV network by ATV in 1981, then by Central from 1982 until 1995, and was hosted by Jim Bowen.

videos.title: You Can't Beat a Bit of Bully
videos.overview: Narrated by comedian Paddy McGuinness and celebrating 35 years of Bullseye featuring the hosts Jim Bowen and Tony Green with celebrity guests Linda Lusardi, Nick Hancock, Anne Diamond, David Baddiel, Katy Brand, Gary Wilmott, Frank Bruno, Tessa Sanderson and legendary dart players John Lowe, Eric Bristow and Bobby George.

videos.title: Christmas Special 2024
videos.overview: Freddie Flintoff hosts a revival of the darts-themed game show in which three teams of two, made up of an amateur darts player and a quiz-loving partner, combine their skills to win points and prizes. All the classic rounds are back including the Category Board, Pounds for Points and Bully's Prize Board, and the winning team has a big decision to make at the end of the show - will they risk everything they've won so far to try to win the mystery star prize? Also joining in the fun is teenage professional Luke Littler, who partners up with Freddie to try to complete a charity challenge.
